bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 166, Number 165 (Wednesday, September 23, 2020)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. SCHIFF:
H.R. 8363.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution under the
General Welfare Clause.
[Page H4885]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Oversight and Reform, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, the Budget, Transportation and Infrastructure, Rules, Foreign Affairs, Ways and Means, Intelligence (Permanent Select), and House Administration, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Protecting Our Democracy Act
